items.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
items.summary: AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of coding agents using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June-July 2026, comprising 7.4M users, 819M conversations, 5.7B LLM calls, and 946T tokens. Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with unique systems implications: e.g., sparse user-initiated turns unfold into autonomous agent loops with nearly 1:1 coupling between LLM calls and tool execution; parallel LLM calls are rare but exist in turns that trigger subagents; KV cache hit rates average 90% within a turn, but fall to 52% across turn boundaries and to 6% after model switches; workflows and user behaviors exhibit diverse, long-tailed resource footprints. We further distinguish short agentic turnaround times from minutes-long user idle periods between turns, and develop a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 87-89% of total idle time. We demonstrate two use cases: (1) a harness-side LLM API keep-alive policy that preserves provider-side context KV cache, reducing token costs by 14.9% on turn boundaries; and (2) a serving-side KV cache residency policy that uses predicted idle time to guide DRAM offloading, reducing time to first token (TTFT) by 3-33% compared with LRU during a one-week evaluation with GitHub Copilot traces.
items.zh: 基于2026年6-7月采样追踪，覆盖740万用户、57亿次LLM调用、946万亿token，刻画编码智能体负载特征。
items.zh_title: GitHub Copilot生产级追踪数据首次公开
items.why: 编码智能体负载与聊天机器人显著不同

items.title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
items.summary: LLM simulations are validated by equivalence with human effects, yet a zero reference passes whenever the human 90 percent interval lies inside the margin, as the human benchmark shows before simulation. When the zero reference fails, planned precision gives independent simulations the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response. In an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's $\pm$0.20 SD passes were zero-reference passes; GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed (1.58 expected without response). In a preregistered audit, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed three intention targets, all zero-reference passes, and the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against humans' 0.351 (zero-reference check added after unblinding; norm beliefs emphasized after inspection). Registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD. A group audit's precision floor is 1.33 facts against a 2.9-fact effect. Report the zero-reference threshold beside every equivalence decision.

items.title: Claude Code Has Been Leaking Secrets through its "Don't Ask Again" Feature
items.summary: Agentic security firm Apiiro found that Claude Code has been exposing secrets in public repositories due to how it stores them in local file on developers' machines to implement "Don't Ask Again". The company identified 1,122 secrets in claude/settings.local.json files and another 1,160 in git history, in the shared settings.json, and in agent chat transcripts stored in repos. By Sergio De Simone
items.zh: Apiiro发现该功能将密钥存入本地settings.local.json，在公开仓库与git历史中共发现超2200条密钥。
items.zh_title: Claude Code“不再询问”功能泄露密钥
items.why: 智能体本地配置成密钥泄露新风险

items.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: The Harness Is the New Operating System
items.summary: At QCon San Francisco 2026, Mad Labs founder and CEO Manju Rajashekhar opened the conference arguing that the harness around an AI model, rather than the model itself, decides what an agent can do and how safely it does it. The keynote mapped the parts of a harness, including context, tools, state, permissions and feedback loops, onto jobs that operating systems already perform. By Andrew Hoblitzell
items.zh: Mad Labs CEO主题演讲认为决定智能体能力与安全的是模型外的harness，含上下文、工具、状态、权限与反馈环。
items.short: harness决定智能体能力与安全
items.why: 智能体工程重心从模型转向框架
